Once you are signed in, Buddy checks your loan history and shows one rate: first-loan pricing if no loan was disbursed this calendar year, or repeat-loan pricing if one was.

*Service-fee estimate follows the proposed formula, capped at R60. Final fees must reflect administration costs; your written quote confirms the amount.

WHY THESE DETAILS?

Your information helps confirm student status, understand your budget and assess affordability. A credit check reviews existing obligations; it does not guarantee an outcome.
